verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only the Marketing Emails API, which creates, updates, and retrieves emails. Segment handling appears only as UI actions, such as choosing recipient segments in the email editor or clicking 'View in segments'. Nothing shows an API to create or update segments, tags, or lists, or to read back their membership, so this applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and update segments, tags, or lists programmatically and read back exactly who is in them
